jurisdictions.name: Santa Fe
jurisdictions.how_locations_are_known: Press coverage and SFPD Facebook posts. The ordinance requires no publication at all, and the Facebook page cannot be read without an account, so the entries here are hand-curated from reporting and carry the date that reporting is good for.

jurisdictions.name: Albuquerque
jurisdictions.how_locations_are_known: The city publishes every location with its direction of travel and the date it went live, and keeps the list current. This is what a city choosing to be legible looks like.

jurisdictions.name: Rio Rancho
jurisdictions.how_locations_are_known: Not published by the city. Every Rio Rancho corridor here was mapped by OpenStreetMap volunteers, most of them in a single December 2025 survey, and each carries its node id and last-edit date so you can judge its age.

program.authority: Santa Fe Traffic Operations Program (STOP), SFCC 1987 Section 24-4
program.location_publication: SFPD Facebook page and posted street signs. No open-data feed, no API, and no ordinance requirement to publish. The Facebook page is login-walled, so it cannot be read programmatically.
